Res.Caption: Sequence
Res.FullDescription: When running Transfer Rules against a workflow in the source component, destination components will be ordered in this sequence.

Res.Caption: Release Gate
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether this link into a Buffer component participates in the Buffer's Release Gate, meaning workflows will have the release rules run on them before being allowed to be transferred to the destination component.

Res.Caption: Transfer Rules Enabled
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether transfer rules are enabled on this link. When un-ticked, no workflows will be permitted to move to the destination component via this link.

Res.Caption: System
Res.FullDescription: The Buffer Management System which contains the 'To' Component for this link.
